motion.relief: to Enlarge Time to Respond to Discovery

title: Plaintiff's Motion to Enlarge Time to Respond to Discovery

body.text: *Example only. Every name, date and fact in this document is invented. It is not a filing and it states no law.*
Plaintiff Jane Q. Example moves the Court for an order enlarging by 14 days the time to respond to Defendant's First Set of Interrogatories.
1. Defendant served its First Set of Interrogatories on March 2, 2026.
2. The interrogatories ask for records that Plaintiff has requested from a third party and has not yet received.
3. On March 20, 2026, Plaintiff asked Defendant to agree to a 14-day extension and has received no answer.
4. The time to respond has not yet run, and no hearing or trial date depends on the responses.
WHEREFORE, Plaintiff asks the Court to enlarge the time to respond to Defendant's First Set of Interrogatories by 14 days.
